## Checklist

- [ ] `mise run check` passes locally
- [ ] A decision changed or was added? Its record in `docs/decisions/` is written or edited, with its index row (or: no decision changed)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under the unreleased version
- [ ] Docs follow the change (`README.md`, `docs/manual.md`), or nothing visible changed
- [ ] Windows considered: paths, `pwsh`, CRLF, processes (CI runs Windows, Ubuntu and macOS)
- [ ] Only placeholder names (`acme`, `client-a`, `example-org`); no real client, company or person, no tokens or private paths
